title: Mixed Event — What lies behind. What lies ahead. — Episode5 The Divide

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.
meta.Event Outline: With the song that made Mafuyu smile complete, positive responses from fans come flooding in. Meanwhile, Mizuki feels like the only one unable to get closer to the other members. One day, the group bumps into An, who has seen a side to Mizuki that the others haven't...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay, I like these motifs.
Let's go with this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yay!
Hehe. This video should be another good one♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, let's keep this pace up and get back to work!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Me too. I'll be muting myself for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, Amia, can you wait a second...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Something came up and it's gonna keep my mom busy, so I'm free to go to that place you were talking about. Wanna go?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The truth is that I told her that I'd be busy, but I'm just too worried about Mizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, does 10:00 outside the station like usual sound good? And try not to be late, okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, fine! You really didn't need to throw that last part in...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, but... We can get a reservation for the VR section in the afternoon, so we can go shopping in the meantime!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Sure, sounds good.
Just don't stay up too late watching anime, alright?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, I'm gonna get back to work now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
There you are.
Alright, let's... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure you're okay, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, you said you didn't feel well the other day, so try not to push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, why are you being so nice to me today...? Is a meteor about to hit? Is the world about to end...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, so shut up!
Is that any way to talk to someone showing concern for you?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! Sorry, my bad!
Everyone knows that you're really a nice person♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does that feel like an insult?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, we gotta go!
Before the light turns red!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
White or pink...?
Such a tough decision...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What are you going on about?
If you don't decide soon, we're gonna miss our reservation.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But this white one goes perfectly with that skirt I bought the other day! At the same time, this pink one's super cute...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, I get it.
I'm going to use the restroom, so try to make a decision before I get back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This always happens. Mizuki always goes on a shopping spree or takes forever to pick something out...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I guess this means I was worried over nothing. Thank goodness.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm not being kept at arm's length like before either, so I think we're moving in the right direction.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I should use this time to organize everything we just bought...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have some of Mizuki's things too, so I should probably sort everything out... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, hi.
I thought you went to the restroom...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you really sure you're okay...? You looked awful just now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I... I did?
I think I'm just sleepy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Cut it out!
Okay, you might be fine physically, but something's definitely going on!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, Ena, keep it down...!
Look, you're scaring the clerk.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've told you this before, but you need to tell me if something's bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I may not always be able to help, but I can at least listen...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have nothing to talk about...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, I guess I'm not as well as I thought I was! I'm fine otherwise, honest...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Geez, I did it again...
I made her worry about me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena is sharper than she lets on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(My head... I feel dizzy...
What's happening...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was handling everything just fine until now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have nothing to talk about...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh! Seriously, what's going on?!
I'm worried sick and this is what I get told?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why won't Mizuki tell me anything...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A reason, a simple explanation, anything...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Otherwise, I'm just gonna drive myself mad running around in circles in my head...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Maybe... Just maybe...
MEIKO might know something...
